name: Zippo
passiveText: Remove 1 Berry from a neighbouring opponent.
activeText: If this Geopal is in a Volcanic region, it may move forward 3 spaces in a single burst.

name: Infernex
passiveText: Gain +1 movement for each additional Volcanic Geopal in play.
activeText: Move forward 3 spaces. All regions behind this Geopal become Volcanic for the rest of the turn.

name: Cindragon
passiveText: Disable the passive abilities of all neighbouring opponent Geopals.
activeText: Move forward 5 spaces, bypassing all traps and movement restrictions.

name: Tadpearl
passiveText: If a Geopal ends its movement on this Geopal's space, this Geopal may choose to move forward 1 space.
activeText: After this ability is used, opposing Geopals that land on Tadpearl’s space next turn must immediately stop.

name: Volfrog
passiveText: Attach to a neighbouring ally Geopal and move with it (staying one space behind) during its standard movement phase. This ability cannot be applied to an ally Geopal's active movement phase.
activeText: Force all neighbouring opposing Geopals to fall back 1 space.

name: Nilgie
passiveText: Cannot be moved by traps, opposing card effects or Geopal abilities.
activeText: Fall back 3 spaces. Any Geopal passed along the way is also knocked back to Nilgie’s final landing space.

name: Toadtem
passiveText: While neighbouring a trap, opponents caught in it cannot escape.
activeText: This Geopal may choose to awaken free of cost if in the third round.

name: Mechaglyph
activeText: Move 2 spaces for every berry discarded regardless of the terrain.

name: Troja
passiveText: This Geopal is not affected by traps set in the Mountain Region.
activeText: Move forward to close the distance with the nearest opposing Geopal.

name: Skippy
passiveText: If this Geopal is in a Mystic Region, draw 3 cards. Arrange them in any order and place them back on top of your deck.
activeText: Move forward 3 spaces.

name: Lilac
passiveText: This Geopal is unaffected by traps, abilities, or action cards for its first 2 turns in play.
activeText: Move forward 1 space for each card discarded from your hand.

name: Telesage
passiveText: This Geopal may swap places with any neighbouring Geopal.
activeText: All opposing Geopals cannot move unless they tag out or discard all Stamina cards first. Allies gain +1 movement this turn. This Geopal cannot move for the rest of the round after using this ability.

name: Inji
passiveText: Once per turn, this Geopal may swap an equipped item with an ally Geopal within 2 spaces.
activeText: Move to the space directly behind the nearest ally Geopal.

name: Jurra
passiveText: This Geopal can hold 2 items and swap items with a neighbouring ally Geopal within 2 spaces.
activeText: Teleport an ally Geopal to the space behind this Geopal.

name: Lazin
passiveText: NA
activeText: Once per game, in a single turn, this Geopal can move one space for every stamina card in play by an opponent. This Geopal must evolve after using this ability.

name: Laxin
passiveText: Each turn, select one stamina card from the deck and add it to this Geopal.
activeText: For every stamina card discarded from this Geopal, the opponent must discard the same number of cards from their hand (maximum 3 cards).

name: Comet
passiveText: While this Geopal is in an Ice Region, ally Volcanic and Desert Geopals are able to move through Ice Regions unaffected.
activeText: Any  opponent within 2 spaces of this Geopal becomes immobile for 1 turn.

name: Astracoon
passiveText: This Geopal ignores all terrain movement restrictions.
activeText: If this Geopal would be moved or inhibited, it may instead discard 2 berries to negate the effect.

name: Empereor
passiveText: This Geopal may skip its movement phase to allow a neighbouring ally to move twice this turn.
activeText: Move forward 5 spaces, then swap the positions of any two Geopals in play or tag team one Geopal in play with one from your hand.

name: Ursulo
passiveText: This Geopal's Berries cannot be knocked off or stolen.
activeText: Throw a neighbouring opponent back to the start of the first region tile at the start of the map.

name: Zippo
passiveText: Remove 1 Berry from a neighbouring opponent.
activeText: Move past a set trap within 2 spaces and destroy it.

name: Sheathix
passiveText: Draw 1 card for each additional ally Forest Geopal in play.
activeText: Move forward 3 spaces. Draw 1 card for each opponent passed.

name: Gardeon
passiveText: When entering a new terrain, all active Geopals move 2 spaces closer (this effect applies at the point of entry at the new terrain and not Gardeon's final landing space)
activeText: Search your deck for any card, show it to your opponent, and add it to your hand. Afterward, this Geopal and one ally Geopal behind it may move forward 3 spaces.

name: Reptail
passiveText: This Geopal can move one extra space for each opponent passed during its movement phase.
activeText: Copy and use the active ability of any Geopal in play.

name: Euko
passiveText: Search your deck for a Stamina card, shuffle your deck, then place the selected stamina card on top.
activeText: Force two opposing Geopals to swap the items they are holding.

name: Nilgie
passiveText: Once per turn, this Geopal can swap an equipped item with an ally Geopal.
activeText: Move forward a number of spaces equal to the number of opponents ahead of this Geopal.

name: Lagoona
passiveText: Allows Mystic and Mountain allies to move in Shadow regions.
activeText: Swap positions with an ally in an Ocean Region.

name: Medeepa
passiveText: When the closest opponent ahead moves more than 5 spaces ahead of this Geopal, this Geopal must move forward regardless of region until no more than 5 spaces are between it and the opposing Geopal.

name: Cupla
passiveText: This Geopal may move over traps without activating them. If this Geopal were to land on a trap, it instead moves to the space after it, without activating the trap.
activeText: Move forward three spaces. If the opponent has already found a treasure orb, this ability may be used twice per turn.

name: Slemo
passiveText: This Geopal awakens into Dralcora if positioned between two allied Geopals. If alone for 5 turns, it awakens into Aroclard.
activeText: Move forward 1 space.

name: Dralcora
passiveText: While this Geopal is on the field, all traps remain active for one additional turn.
activeText: Move a neighboring opponent forward the maximum possible distance (based on its maximum stamina). All opponents become immobile next turn.

name: Aroclard
passiveText: After this Geopal moves, it cannot move again on its next turn.
activeText: Send both this Geopal and the closest opponent back to the starting space of the map.

name: Aloka
passiveText: This Geopal ignores traps in Shadow regions and moves through them without activating them or stopping.
activeText: All ally and opponent Geopals move 1 space closer to Aloka.

name: Gripull
passiveText: Pull an ally or opponent Geopal that is located within 3 spaces to a position 1 space away from this Geopal.
activeText: Leap over an opponent that is within 3 spaces ahead, landing 1 space ahead of the opponent.

name: Shadrex
passiveText: Increase the movement of all Runner-type Geopals by 1 space (this does not apply to active abilities).
activeText: Discard any number of cards from your hand; your opponent must discard the same amount from their hand.

name: Skippy
passiveText: If this Geopal is in a Shadow Region, draw 3 cards. Arrange them in any order and place them back on top of your deck.
activeText: Prevent an opponent within 3 spaces from moving on their next turn.

name: Descarfo
passiveText: This Geopal is not affected by the first trap that it activates.
activeText: Deploy a mirage double into a trap. If the trap is activated, the mirage is affected instead of this Geopal.

name: Imphant
passiveText: Immune to all secondary effects of traps.
activeText: Roll to the end of a terrain without being inhibited by terrain type.

name: Shifting Sands
passiveText: Change all regions to desert for two turns.

name: Jungle Surge
passiveText: Change all regions to forest for two turns.

name: Ice Age
passiveText: Change all regions to ice for two turns.

name: Ground Fissure
passiveText: Change all regions to mountain for two turns.

name: Aura Veil
passiveText: Change all regions to mystic for two turns.

name: Geyser Blast
passiveText: Change all regions to ocean for two turns.

name: Dark Eclipse
passiveText: Change all regions to shadow for two turns.

name: Magma Burst
passiveText: Change all regions to volcano for two turns.

name: Sand Cyclone
passiveText: Traps an opposing Geopal for two rounds. If this trap is placed in a Desert Region, the trapped Geopal must also discard all equipped items.

name: Root Snare
passiveText: Traps an opposing Geopal for two rounds. If this trap is placed in a Forest Region, the trapped Geopal must discard all equipped stamina.

name: Snap Freeze
passiveText: Traps an opposing Geopal for two rounds. If this trap is placed in an Ice Region, all neighboring ally Geopals are also trapped for two rounds.

name: Rock Slide
passiveText: Traps an opposing Geopal for two rounds. If this trap is placed in a Mountain Region, the trapped Geopal is also knocked back two spaces.

name: Mind Shackle
passiveText: Traps an opposing Geopal for two rounds. If this trap is placed in a Mystic Region, the trapped Geopal must move backwards for its first movement turn.

name: Water Prison
passiveText: Traps an opposing Geopal for two rounds. If this trap is placed in an Ocean Region, the trapped Geopal can only move after the two turns if there is a

name: Shadow Hold
passiveText: Traps an opposing Geopal for two rounds. If no ally is neighbouring after 2 rounds, the trapped Geopal is moved to the starting space of the map.

name: Magma Drift
passiveText: Traps an opposing Geopal for two rounds. If this trap is placed in a Volcano Region, the next move phase for the trapped Geopal is halved (rounding up).

name: Portal Disc
passiveText: To be placed on a space occupied by one of your Geopals. When two portal discs are in play, your Geopals may teleport from one to the other.

name: Adrenalana
passiveText: If an opponent is 5 or more spaces ahead when this is equipped, the Geopal may take two movement turns. Discard after use.

name: Sense
passiveText: When this item is attached to a Geopal, the effect of the next trap that it activates is negated. Discard after use.

name: Orb
passiveText: Allows one Geopal to evolve when equipped without a stamina cost. Must be discarded after use.

name: Rope
passiveText: Allows for a Geopal to tow an ally one space behind as it moves. The tether breaks if an opponent moves either Geopal apart or if the towed Geopal moves ahead of the leading Geopal.

name: Stealth Cloak
passiveText: The Geopal wearing this is unaffected by all opponent abilities.

name: Tag Team
passiveText: Swap any active Geopal for one in your hand.

name: Re-stock
passiveText: Select a Geopal character from your deck and add it to your hand. If there are no Geopals in your deck, this card has no effect.

name: Forager
passiveText: Search your deck for a Stamina card, add it to your hand, then shuffle your deck.

name: Knock Off
passiveText: Force a neighbouring opponent to discard an equipped item.

name: Thief
passiveText: If one of your Geopals is neighbouring an opponent, use this to discard one random card from that opponent’s hand.

name: Nostalgia Box
passiveText: Reach into the past and reclaim a cherished memory. Select a card from your discard pile and return it to your hand.

name: Community
passiveText: While this card is in play, a maximum of four ally Geopals can be on the field.

name: Natural Form
passiveText: Discard an active Terraform card controlled by an opponent.

name: Extractor
passiveText: Discard any number of stamina cards from a selected Geopal (ally or opponent).

name: Observatory
passiveText: View your opponent’s hand.

name: Faction Tag
passiveText: Look at the top three cards of your deck. If any are a Geopal, you may tag them with an active Geopal. The tagged Geopal returns to your hand.

name: Search
passiveText: Search your deck for a Geopal and place it on top of your deck.

name: Pandart's Nilgie
passiveText: Pandart’s Nilgie never pays full price—once per turn, it may sneakily swap an equipped item with a neighbouring ally Geopal.
activeText: Late to the party? Not a chance! Pandart’s Nilgie dashes forward, moving a number of spaces equal to the number of opponents ahead.

name: Pandart's Zippo
passiveText: Pandart’s Zippo locks eyes with a neighbouring opponent and—oops!—their Berry is gone. Must’ve been the intense stare…
activeText: When in a Volcanic region, Pandart’s Zippo cranks up the heat and blazes forward 3 spaces in a fiery dash. Try to keep up!

name: Descarfo [medal]
passiveText: This Geopal is not affected by the first trap it activates—was that just the desert heat playing tricks, or did something glimmer for a second?
activeText: Deploy a mirage double into a trap. If the trap is activated, the mirage is affected instead—though for a moment, it almost seemed like this Geopal shimmered too.

name: Empereor [medal]
passiveText: This Geopal may skip its movement phase to allow a neighbouring ally to move twice this turn. A faint shimmer trails in its wake, as if the air itself bends to its command.
activeText: Move forward 5 spaces, then swap the positions of any two Geopals in play or tag team one Geopal in play with one from your hand. For just a moment, the battlefield feels different—was that a trick of the light?

name: Telesage [medal]
passiveText: This Geopal may swap places with any neighbouring Geopal. For just a moment, was there a shimmer in its step?
activeText: All opposing Geopals cannot move unless they tag out or discard all Stamina cards first. Allies gain +1 movement this turn. This Geopal cannot move for the rest of the round after using this ability. As the turn ends, something almost glimmers in the air—was it always there?

name: Inji [medal]
passiveText: Once per turn, this Geopal may swap an equipped item with an ally Geopal within 2 spaces. For a brief moment, the item seems to shimmer—was it always in that Geopal’s hands?
activeText: Move to the space directly behind the nearest ally Geopal. A faint glimmer follows Inji’s path—did it just slip through reality itself?

name: Cindragon [medal]
passiveText: The air around this Geopal shimmers with heat, sapping the strength of all neighbouring opponents. Their passive abilities falter, like a flame struggling against the wind.
activeText: Move forward 5 spaces, bypassing all traps and movement restrictions. In its wake, a brief flicker of embers lingers—was that just the heat, or something more?

name: Beakabou
passiveText: Master of camouflage and intelligence, ensuring balance in the forest region.

name: Galsage
passiveText: Master of the winds, able to create powerful mountain-crumbling gusts.

name: Metrark
passiveText: Lurks in the deep, emits a glow at night, carves coastlines by swimming too close to land.

name: Sharlitan
passiveText: Master of the shadows, can traverse between regions using shadow power.

name: Frolick
passiveText: Creator of lava flow and volcanic activity, thrives in magma.

name: Nynne's Gardeon
passiveText: When entering a new terrain, all active Geopals move 2 spaces closer (this effect applies at the point of entry at the new terrain and not Gardeon's final landing space)
activeText: Search your deck for any card, show it to your opponent, and add it to your hand. Afterward, this Geopal and one ally Geopal behind it may move forward 3 spaces.
